limits: Same-prepare choice effects compare matched target geometry on a tuning input; they are not official scored-case paired old/new measurements.
Official paired ratios compare reference against this submission; cross-job calibrated deltas are descriptive, with different fixtures/selections/context.
Source inclusion, target eligibility, successful completed comparison, accepted marker and profiled execution are separate evidence.
Incomplete/skipped receipts give no keyed-vs-parent gain; preserve reason and any partial raw samples.
Profile durations, raw events, raw-minus-overhead and calibrated times remain separate.
Multiple preparation receipts are retained; no unverified last-record association to official profiles.
